responsibility: Provides the non-EABI uClinux ELF target configuration for Arm. It disables PLT use, defaults to a single PIC base, adds Linux/uClinux preprocessor builtins, defines start/end files and link sequences suitable for elf2flt systems, selects Linux library and linker specs without relying on config/linux.h, and enables word relocations expected by this uClinux ELF environment.
